content.short: WeFi is a decentralized "deobank" providing under-collateralized lending and non-custodial global payment solutions.
content.description: WeFi is a comprehensive decentralized finance platform and "deobank" that offers a suite of advanced financial services, including under-collateralized borrowing and a robust leverage engine. The protocol allows users to open leveraged positions on major assets like Bitcoin and Ethereum with minimal downpayments, enhancing capital efficiency. WeFi also provides on-chain bank accounts integrated with global payment solutions, such as the WeFi Visa card, enabling a seamless transition between decentralized assets and everyday spending. By combining non-custodial control with institutional-grade financial tools, WeFi aims to provide a more accessible and efficient global banking alternative for the Web3 era.
